newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch AEX share index up as market bets on results.
newsitem.headline: Dutch AEX share index up as market bets on results.

text.p: 1000 GMT - Dutch shares add to opening gains with several stocks outperforming market in anticipation of company results due later this week.
* AEX main share index up 7.26 points at 988.00.
* WoltersKluwer, due to release first-half results on Tuesday, adds 15.10 guilders to 288.00 guilders in busy trade.
* KLM, also reporting tomorrow, up 4.20 to 77.20 guilders.
* Hoogovens, publishing on Wednesday, rises 3.40 to 138.20.
* Akzo down from earlier peaks, but still up 2.30 at 342.80.
* Unilever adds 6.20 guilders to 473.60 on broker upgrade and in aftermath of results, stock split-announcement.
